headline: Apple can't predict when iPhone Duo supply constraints will ease
summary: Apple says it cannot predict when supply constraints on its foldable iPhone Duo will ease, even as production ramps up, with shipping delays expected to stretch into next year. The device, which sold out after proving popular with buyers willing to pay around $2,000, likely won't be back in stock in time for this year's holidays.
